implementation.resource_policy: GPU_H3_HEAVY is exclusive; CPU/text/audio channels are independent

assertions: attempt log cursor returns persisted outbox events
GPU heavy resource admits one active claim while CPU proceeds
expired lease is reconciled automatically by a fresh claim
retry preserves attempts and clone creates a new id with overrides
cancel remains cooperative and terminal completion releases resource
same idempotency key is replay-safe and invalid percent is rejected

notes: No external provider, upload, telemetry, or public-network dependency is used. Full release gate and manual Windows restart/UAT remain required.
